Sharing your assessment results with SOC-CMM will help to create a global benchmark of SOC maturity and can help to identify and report on trends. This information is subsequently used to improve the SOC-CMM tools or create new resources and guidance for the SOC community to address topics that are seeing a lower maturity score. The results are also used as part of a broader benchmarking database to report on SOC maturity trends.

2.4.9 Have you optimized secure remote working capabilities for SOC employees? Secure working enabled means secure access (MFA, encryption, etc.), secure working facilitated also means equipped and performing
5.2.8 Do you actively measure and improve data source coverage? Data source coverage should be optimized to avoid blind spots in monitoring
2.7.3 Supervised machine learning Machine learning trained on a predefined data set with known good and bad traffic
2.7.4 Unsupervised machine learning Machine learning trained without a predefined data set

2.17.36 Restore integrity verification Verification that backups and restored assets do not contain IoCs or backdoors used in the initial incident
